traits.notes: The seedling shows a whorled arrangement of five simple, elliptic leaves with rugose texture and entire margins. The stem is woody, ridged, and dark brownish-green. A small hole is present on one leaf, but no other damage is evident. The plant is tagged with a label ("DICHOS 2"), which is not part of the plant. A. Leaf Arrangement & Architecture

B. Leaf Complexity

D. Stem & Shoot Traits
    17. Stem type, may not be visible (woody / herbaceous): woody (stem is firm, with visible bark and nodes, consistent with a young woody plant)
